text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Bahraini press on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahraini Saudi Bank says net profits rise to 2.5 million dinars in first nine months of 1996. Deposits increase to 100 million dinars.
- Mininster of finance says Bahrain's expenditure will rise to $3.8 billion while revenue will rise to $3.5 billion over next two years.
- Kuwait central bank governor says four Kuwiati banks engaged in merger talks.
- Bahrain Monetary Agency governor says banks in Bahrian and other Gulf States must join forces to survive in the future. Intensive efforts towards mergers must be made.
